notes:
- First tester build.
- Licence screen on first start: send the machine ID to get a licence file.
- Sweep limit presets in Settings: Low 256, Medium 1,024, High 4,096, Extreme 65,536, or Custom.
- Settings shows whether your network fits the chosen sweep limit, with a one-click fix.
- Updates tab checks this feed at startup and tells you when a newer build exists.
- Stress history is capped at the newest 300 rows and the file is trimmed to about 1 MB.
